name: Raghunath International Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1995, Raghunath International Ltd is in the business of Real Estate and Development.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
RIL is in the trading and agency business. 
The company is focusing on Real Estate and allied businesses and will formulate its business strategies accordingly.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.37 times its book value
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 6.24% over last 3 years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.1.04 Cr.
Company has high debtors of 287 days.
